title: M1: Infrastructure & Architecture Foundation [ITIL: Service Strategy]
description:
## Phase: COMPLETED (100%)

### ITIL: Service Strategy | PMP: Initiating

Core platform infrastructure enabling all subsequent development phases.

### Delivered Components
- PostgreSQL database: 145 tables, 50 enums (Supabase)
- Google Cloud Run: backend + frontend auto-scaling services
- 6 GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (test, deploy, build)
- Firebase Hosting + Supabase Storage integration
- Redis cache (Upstash) with HybridCache fallback
- Docker containerization for Cloud Run deployment
- 299 database migrations framework
- Multi-environment config (dev/staging/production)

### Key Metrics
- First commit: 2025-07-22
- Infrastructure complete: 2025-09-30
- Workflows: CI, Deploy Backend, Deploy Frontend, Mobile Build, Inspector Build, Inspector CI

title: M2: Core Backend API — 30 Modules [ITIL: Service Design]
description:
## Phase: COMPLETED (100%)

### ITIL: Service Design | PMP: Executing

Full backend API implementation with 30 modules following 3-tier architecture.

### Architecture: API Layer -> Service Layer -> Repository Layer -> Database

### Delivered Components
- 30 backend modules, 31 API routers
- Auth: JWT (30min/30d) + 2FA TOTP + bcrypt (12 rounds)
- RBAC: 47 roles, 335 permissions, per-user overrides, audit trail
- 873 fiscal services across 21 ministries
- 36 predefined business workflows (v2 engine)
- Payment processing: BANGE (mobile money, card, bank transfer)
- Communications: 29 email, 31 SMS, 9 push, 16 in-app templates
- Async database layer: asyncpg connection pooling
- Pydantic v2 strict validation on all models

### Key Metrics
- API endpoints: 100+
- Database tables: 145
- Permissions: 335
- Communication templates: 85

title: M3: Frontend Dashboard — 41+ Modules [ITIL: Service Design]
description:
## Phase: COMPLETED (95%)

### ITIL: Service Design | PMP: Executing

Full frontend dashboard with 41+ modules for all user roles.

### Architecture: Next.js 14 App Router + React Query + Zustand + Shadcn/UI

### Delivered Components
- 41+ frontend modules with App Router and i18n routing
- Role-based dashboards: admin, agent, supervisor, citizen
- Service request wizard (multi-step, cache-first architecture)
- Trilingual i18n: Spanish, French, English (11,400+ keys per locale)
- Shadcn/UI component library with Tailwind CSS design system
- React Query for server state, Zustand for client state
- Dynamic menu configuration per role and entity
- Bundle workflow UI for commercial inspections

title: M5: AI, OCR & Document Intelligence [ITIL: Service Transition]
description:
## Phase: COMPLETED (90%)

### ITIL: Service Transition | PMP: Executing

AI-powered chatbot and document intelligence system.

### RAG Chatbot Pipeline
User Query -> Embedding (text-embedding-004) -> Hybrid Search (70% semantic + 30% full-text) -> Context Assembly -> Gemini 2.5 Flash (35 tools) -> Self-Reflection (score < 5 regenerates) -> Response (15 formats)

### OCR Pipeline
Document Upload -> Template Matching (39 schemas) -> Field Extraction (bounding boxes) -> Schema Validation (70+ rules) -> Risk Analysis (12 steps) -> Structured Data

### Delivered
- Gemini 2.5 Flash RAG chatbot: 35 tools, self-reflection, 15 formats
- 39 OCR document schemas with template-based extraction
- SchemaValidationEngine: 70+ JSON rules
- RiskAnalyzer: 12-step pipeline
- pgvector: 768-dim embeddings, hybrid search
- OWASP security: prompt injection detection (30+ patterns)

title: M6: Bundle Workflow & Field Inspections [ITIL: Service Transition]
description:
## Phase: IN PROGRESS (75%)

### ITIL: Service Transition | PMP: Executing

Commercial license bundle workflow with multi-entity validation and field inspections.

### Bundle Payment Flow
Commercial License -> AI Classification -> Zone Resolution (Levenshtein) -> Obligation Generation -> Multi-Entity Validation (TESORO + AYUNTAMIENTO + CAMARA) -> Payment -> Receipt PDF

### Concurrency: Pessimistic Locking
Lock Order: commercial_licenses (FOR UPDATE) -> service_requests (partial unique index) -> license_obligations (batch UPDATE) -> service_payments (INSERT)
Transaction timeouts: lock_timeout=3s, statement_timeout=5s

### Completed (Phase 8: 13 commits)
Multi-entity validation flow, receipt generation, security leak fix, MVCC race fix, city routing, widget scoping, queue_stats bundle-aware, staging reset script

### Remaining (Phase 9)
MIN_* entity stats, 409 concurrency guard, UI1-UI9 polish, citizen bundle page, email parity, agent workload display

title: M7: Testing & Quality Assurance [ITIL: Service Transition]
description:
## Phase: IN PROGRESS (30%)

### ITIL: Service Transition | PMP: Monitoring and Controlling

Quality assurance covering all critical business flows.

### Test Strategy
- Unit Tests: Pydantic model validation, utility functions
- Integration Tests: Real database (NO mocks - project rule), asyncpg
- E2E Tests: Playwright for frontend critical paths
- Security: OWASP Top 10 assessment, penetration testing
- Performance: Load testing (1M citizens, 100+ concurrent agents)

### Coverage Targets
- Critical paths (auth, payments, workflows): 80%+
- API endpoints (31 routers): Contract tests
- RBAC (335 permissions): Enforcement verification
- OCR (39 schemas): Extraction accuracy

### Also includes
- RAG chatbot Phase 2-3 bugfix and production hardening
- Security audit with OWASP Top 10 mapping

title: M8: Production Release v1.0 [ITIL: Service Operation]
description:
## Phase: PLANNED (10%)

### ITIL: Service Operation | PMP: Closing

Production deployment and operational readiness.

### Deployment Architecture
Staging (current): Cloud Run us-central1, 0-10 instances, Supabase shared
Production (target): Dedicated Cloud Run, Cloud SQL or dedicated Supabase, CDN, monitoring

### Deliverables
- Production Cloud Run services with blue-green deployment
- Dedicated production database with backup/DR
- SSL/TLS and CDN configuration
- Monitoring: uptime (99.5% SLA), latency (<500ms alert), error rate (<1%)
- Incident response runbook and on-call procedures
- User documentation and agent training materials (100+ agents)
- Mobile app store submissions (Google Play)

title: M9: Continuous Improvement [ITIL: CSI]
description:
## Phase: PLANNED (0%)

### ITIL: Continual Service Improvement | PMP: Ongoing

Post-launch optimization and platform evolution.

### Performance Optimization
- Database: query profiling, index optimization, partitioning
- API: response time <200ms, N+1 elimination, cursor pagination
- Cache: Redis TTL tuning, hot-path preloading
- Infrastructure: Cloud Run sizing, CDN, read replicas if needed

### New Channels
- WhatsApp Business API integration
- USSD channels (Getesa, Muni operators)
- Multi-channel notification routing with fallback

### Multi-Country Framework
Prepare Facil for deployment to additional countries:
Country-agnostic configuration -> Government structure template -> Payment gateway abstraction -> Locale and legal framework config -> Multi-tenant architecture
